command: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' AND (tablename LIKE 'acct_%' OR tablename IN ('audit_log','cafe_stock_movements','student_balance_transactions')) ORDER BY tablename

SELECT c.relname, t.tgname, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE c.relname IN ('audit_log','cafe_stock_movements','student_balance_transactions') AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY c.relname, t.tgname
